## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (82%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Benign and Normal on this simulated frozen section, with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 82%, Normal 16%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability (70% error AUROC), 92% OOD (12 regions) [F6] | Passes QC despite high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes (same top class) | Independent models agree on top |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%), 4/5 Normal (85% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors mostly labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 5, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.98 contribution) [F2], but unreliable (0/20 AI spot-check) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.29 contribution) opposing invasive carcinoma [F3] (18/20 spot-check) · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Typical score nudging toward invasive (+0.16 contribution) [F4] (12/20 spot-check) · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (-0.14 contribution) reducing invasive score (18/20 spot-check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 spans 0); top driver normal lobules is unreliable (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and 92% OOD appearance mask focal atypia or blur the Benign versus Normal boundary.
- Elevated risk in regions 9 and 10 (72%, 67%) reflects focal pathology diluted across the whole slide.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 8**: Inspect highest risk tiles (72%, 67%, 21%) and inferior margin (called clear [F7]).
2. **Regions 5, 6, 10**: Verify benign tubules versus normal lobules (unreliable concept) to separate Benign from Normal.
3. **Regions 1, 7**: Check region 1 for duct-confined atypia (67% superior margin) and region 7 for invasion.
